title: Close Command
description: Adds a command to close Minecraft in a certain amount of time.
body:
Close Command

  A lightweight client-side mod that adds /close — tell Minecraft to shut itself down after a set amount of time. Great for falling asleep mid-AFK, capping a play session, or just walking
  away without leaving the game running all night.

  Features

  - Flexible time input — /close 5 minutes, /close 90s, /close 1:30:00 hours, /close 5h, even /close 2 years. Units from milliseconds to years, and decimals work too.
  - /close status — check how much time is left.
  - /close cancel — call it off.
  - One timer at a time — running /close again just replaces the old timer, so they never stack up.
  - Smart tab-completion — suggests units and examples as you type.
  - Two modes — closes instantly by default, or add safe to save your world first (/close 10m safe).

  Usage

  /close <time> [safe]
  /close status
  /close cancel

  Client-side only — no server install needed. Requires Fabric API.
